method.chain: random-site heat-bath (Gibbs) update, stationary distribution P; time counted in single-site updates (L=4 updates = one sweep)

candidates.pca: top-2 eigenvectors of the P-weighted indicator covariance C(0)
candidates.tica1/4/8: TICA / linear VAC: C(tau) v = lam C(0) v, lag tau
candidates.tica*-reg: TICA in the leading-PC subspace keeping VAR_KEEP of variance
candidates.lda: Fisher LDA on string-level descent basins (regularised)

metrics.vamp2_tau: VAMP-2 (Wu & Noe 2020) of the 2-D basis at lag TAU_EVAL
metrics.variance_share: share of total indicator variance in the plane
metrics.basin_separation: P-weighted fraction of strings whose plane-nearest support string is in the same descent basin
metrics.trustworthiness/continuity: Venna & Kaski (2001), P-weighted by sampling N_SAMPLE strings, k=K_NN
metrics.coverage: grid=GRID; isolated_mass = P-mass in cells outside the largest 8-connected occupied component

method.note_eckart_young: For any linear basis V (a fixed 2-D subspace), trace(V'C0 V) <= lambda1+lambda2 of C0: no linear combination of the indicators exceeds PC1+PC2 in explained variance.
